text: Anyone else frustrated that clients pay 60 days late? I spent my whole Friday chasing invoices again and I hate it.
We just launched InvoiceBot, a new tool for freelancers. Check it out and tell us what you think!
Pro tip for new freelancers: always ask for a deposit up front.

Some background first. I run a two person design studio and we mostly do brand work for restaurants and small shops. We have been going for six years and the work itself is good. The part that is breaking me is getting paid. Three clients are over sixty days late right now, I am stuck chasing them every week and I am honestly frustrated enough to quit. I built a spreadsheet and a little script to send reminders but it barely helps.
I switched from one invoicing app to another after they raised prices, and I am stuck with the same late payers either way.
